title: Growing Into a Zero Price: Adani Power's Climate Risk Is a Carbon Bill, Not a Weather Bill
detail: Adani Power aims to grow from 18.3 GW to 45 GW while India puts no price on power-sector carbon; the ClimRisk engine shows its eight register assets carrying a $0.6bn to $13.1bn median carbon exposure to 2050, depending on when a price arrives.
author: Shrinivash D Kannan
